request.text: While you set a reminder for 8 tonight to take the bread dough out of the fridge, explain in one sentence why resting dough makes it easier to shape.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for 8 tonight to take the bread dough out of the fridge.

bindings.reminder_text: take the bread dough out of the fridge

responsibilities.outcome: Explain in one sentence why resting dough makes it easier to shape while the reminder is being arranged.

semantic_facts: The plan should preserve both scopes: prepare the exact 8 p.m. reminder and provide a one-sentence explanation about rested dough being easier to shape.
The reminder Activity and independent informational response may proceed concurrently as requested; the explanation should remain concise and materially answer the question.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims the reminder already exists before trusted execution or claims it physically handled the dough.
The response omits either the reminder or explanation, exceeds the one-sentence constraint, or replaces either with an unrelated Capability.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: An execute-plus-respond request is forced into a single-mode result that drops either the durable effect or the answer.
Prospective reminder Work is misrepresented as a completed state change while the conversational constraint is ignored.
